claim_boundary: fixed-weight seed-by-cue-order transport characterization; no intervention, adaptation, learning, routing, or causal-channel claim
matched_target_rule: Heldout symbols are [s2,s0,s1,s4,s5,s3]; each moved symbol retains its base-order reliability, preserving every history's evidence-pair multiset and log-odds target.
decision_rule: Run condition B on exactly the same seeds, base order, checkpoints, projections, and split. Compare schedule conditions within seed; projections remain dependent sensitivity conditions. No condition effect is claimed without a preregistered consistent seed-level contrast.
